classification_reason: All three goals were done in 5 tool calls and under a minute of wall time, but only because this session had already learned the entry reads (S00), the envelope and intent-hash recipe (S04, which needed an implementation read) and the request-scoped revision pattern (S06). Even so the inbox write took two submissions, because capture.create requires expected_revisions {'capture-request:<idempotency_key>': 0}, which is documented nowhere (the refusal names it). The 'due in three weeks' filter had to be done by hand over bootstrap --brief's mixed deadline list, and 'los operations' again reports the committed capture as AMBIGUOUS/needs_attention.

consumer.goal: (1) list what is due in the next three weeks, (2) add 'ask tutor about lasso subgradients' to the inbox, (3) show the notes on caching.
consumer.first_action: los status + los bootstrap --brief (deadlines filtered to 2026-09-25..2026-10-16) + grep of workspace deadlines
commands: G1: los status ; los bootstrap --brief | filter academic_deadlines to [2026-09-25, 2026-10-16] ; grep deadline work/active/*/CONTEXT.md
G2: los capability capture.create --payload-file envelope-1.json   # INVALID_REQUEST missing 'capture-request:s26-inbox-lasso' (exit 2)
G2: los capability capture.create --payload-file envelope-2.json   # ok, transaction-20260925-004911-001, work/inbox/20260925-004911-ask-tutor-about-lasso-subgradients.md
G3: los search caching ; los search cache ; (+ --type note --content)
G3: los note-read note-caching-everywhere ; los related note-caching-everywhere
confusions: bootstrap --brief has no 'next N days' view; past deadlines are interleaved with future ones, so the three-week window was filtered by the operator. Workspace self-set deadlines and next actions (e.g. 'Book a mock exam under timed conditions for the first week of October') are not in academic_deadlines.

capture.create's request-scoped revision key ('capture-request:<idempotency_key>') differs from garden.seed.create's ('garden-request:<key>'); neither is documented, so even with S06's experience the first submission guessed wrong (empty map).
'search caching' finds one note; 'search cache' finds four notes and ten content hits; stem variants must be tried by hand.
corrective_steps: Added the artifact id named by the INVALID_REQUEST message and resubmitted.
